enchantments.tooltip: Riposte +1: This item enchants its user with incredible awareness and speed, granting a +1 Insight bonus to AC and to Saves.
Insightful Combat Mastery +2: +2 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Disable Device +6: Passive: +6 Competence bonus to the Disable Device skill.
Open Lock +6: Passive: +6 Competence bonus to the Open Lock skill.
